description: Run a perf-monitor benchmark batch and return per-metric leaders, risk flags and a comparison of available case results. Give it a target route and a matrix of cases (each a name + query params that select a variant on that route); it navigates, records, and benchmarks each case on the device, then ranks them. This blocks until the batch completes (can be minutes for large batches). The app must have the target route render its variants from the params.

bounceRoute.description: Screen to bounce to between runs so the test screen fully remounts. Defaults to "/" (or a stub if target is "/").

captureRenders.description: Capture per-component render counts/durations during each run (needs @buoy-gg/highlight-updates installed; dev builds only). Adds instrumentation overhead that can vary with the workload. Default true.

cases.description: The variants to compare. Case #0 is the baseline for deltas.

name.description: Display name for this variant (becomes the saved run's name).

params.description: Query params applied to the route for this case, e.g. { "renderer": "v2", "count": "100" }.

route.description: Optional per-case route override; defaults to targetRoute.

coolDownMs.description: Idle between runs/cases for thermal recovery. Default 2000.

deviceId.description: The device to act on: its id from list_devices or from your instructions. Pass it whenever more than one app may be connected. Once a call names a device, later calls in this session use it when deviceId is left out.

discardWarmupRuns.description: Discard first N runs of each case before taking the median. Default 0.

maxWaitMs.description: Safety cap for how long to wait for completion. Defaults to ~3× the estimate + 60s.

navTimeoutMs.description: Max wait for navigation per run. Default 5000.

perCaseDurationMs.description: How long to record each run. Default 5000.

reloadBetweenCases.description: Fully reload JS between cases (needs <AutomationResumer/> mounted). Default false.

runsPerCase.description: Runs per case; the median becomes the canonical result. Default 3 (1–10).

settleMs.description: Idle gap after navigation before recording. Default 600.

shuffleCases.description: Interleave and shuffle case order to reduce order-related bias. Default on for >3 cases.

targetRoute.description: The screen to benchmark, e.g. "/perf-test". Reads case params to pick a variant.

name: run_benchmark_batch
